Bike Rally Training Rides

Toronto, Canada · Training ride · Road

Bike Rally Training Rides is a series of road training rides in Toronto, Canada. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 8:00 am local time from Changes weekly (listed on each calendar event).

For visitors

Run for riders training for the August Bike Rally. The pages don't say whether riders who haven't registered for the Rally can join, so email the Rally first. Some rides include a box lunch at the break ($10, cash or tap, 2026).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike Rally Training Rides group ride

Weekly long training rides for the Friends For Life Bike Rally, the August ride from Toronto to Montréal that raises money for PWA (600 km, with 300 km and 100 km options). Routes head out of the city to places like Burlington, Glen Williams and Keswick, with a sign-in and announcements at the start. Montréal and Kingston riders have their own training rides.
